verses.text: A Song of Ascents, of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brothers to dwell together in unity!
verses.textZh: （大衛上行之詩。）看哪，弟兄和睦同居是何等地善，何等地美！

verses.text: It is like the precious oil upon the head, Coming down upon the beard, [Even] Aaron's beard, Coming down upon the edge of his robes.
verses.textZh: 這好比那貴重的油澆在亞倫的頭上，流到鬍鬚，又流到他的衣襟；

verses.text: It is like the dew of Hermon Coming down upon the mountains of Zion; For there the LORD commanded the blessing-- life forever.
verses.textZh: 又好比黑門的甘露降在錫安山；因為在那裡有耶和華所命定的福，就是永遠的生命。
